Lesson: before editing anything on an editorial complaint, verify WHICH file the complaint describes against the bytes actually sent - the 'highlighted markings' were the latexdiff marks of the changes-marked copy sitting in the supplement slot, byte-identical to the staged file, and no shipped source carried any highlighting at all.
immutable_history_note: Two recorded blemishes live in immutable, already-pushed history and are disclosed here rather than rewritten (rewriting would move published tags, break the Data Availability Statement, and violate D-0045): (1) the pass-54 commit c0028c1's MESSAGE cites anchor 4d6bd1b, which resolves to nothing - the manifest committed IN that commit records the correct anchor b7abf61da; commit messages cannot be corrected without rewriting pushed history. (2) The copies of THIS manifest frozen inside tags v2.26 through v2.28 carry their as-minted values, including v2.28's published_commit whose tail was invented while expanding a 9-hex abbreviation; the value was corrected on main at pass-56 and check_manifest has gated commit-field resolvability since. Tagged states are never edited in place (D-0045), so the in-tag copies stand as minted. Recorded at pass-57 (D-0062).
published_commit_note: published_commit is the commit that carried the previous freeze's mint onto the published branch (for pass-63, the v2.35 close). It is NOT the same object as anchor_commit, which names this pass's apply commit; both resolve on the public branch. This field went four passes stale before pass-53 because nothing gates it - recompute it at every mint, and never assume anchor and published are the same commit.
source_files_note: Canonical LaTeX sources whose RENDERS are tracked in files[] but which were not themselves hashed. The asymmetry has a failure mode and it fired in pass-42: cover_letter.tex was edited and the render was not rebuilt, so cover_letter.pdf still matched its recorded digest and the gate stayed green while the letter that ships to the editor still carried a retracted phrasing. Hashing the sources here makes that visible without changing files[], so the tracked-file count is unchanged and every recorded 15/15 remains true. main.tex is absent because it is already tracked in files[].
